page.overview:
What is Ikoria?

Ikoria (pronounced Ick-oria) is a "Monster World" plane with minimal civilization and giant beasts.

Ikoria is a plane ruled by monsters, where human civilization ekes out a living in a handful of heavily defended sanctuaries. Though most humans exhibit a militant attitude toward monsters, humans known as bonders can form a metaphysical bond with them. A massive island, the continent is made up of five regions known as "triomes."

The appearance of a new crystal formation outside Drannith known as the Ozolith spawned a new era of wild mutation on Ikoria. In 4561 AR, Lukka, the captain of Drannith's defense forces and fiancé of General Kudro's daughter Jirina, suddenly bonded with a monster. After he was exiled from the sanctuary, the new bonder besieged the city with a force of monsters, killing the General, shattering the Ozolith, and igniting his planeswalker's spark in the process.

Ikoria was a target in New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse. With no plane of her own to defend, Vivien took to arranging the defense of Ikoria alongside Chevill and Jirina Kudro. The crystals of Ikoria began seeping glistening oil and producing copper oxide growths, but quickly the natural mutations fought against it, granting oil-vaporizing crystals to the defending beasts of Ikoria.
